forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-AMBIGUOUS on 2026-07-18. Pakistan-mediated process reached final agreed-upon text June 12-14 with Pakistani PM announcing digital signing; however text-finalization via shuttle diplomacy constitutes a written-message exchange via mediator, not a convened session with named US and Iranian principals simultaneously present. MOU signed digitally June 17, after EOD June 16 horizon. No official Iranian MFA statement explicitly rescinding the June 1 suspension is confirmed before June 16 EOD. Falls under ambiguity_rule: written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. HUMAN_REVIEW: if CNN liveblog 2026-06-12 or NPR 2026-06-15 explicitly confirms a simultaneously convened session with named US and Iranian officials, verdict should upgrade to YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: Mandatory reasoning update 2026-07-18 (60 days stale; three major structural events without update: first reading 106-0 June, final reading 62-0 July 17, election fixed at Oct 27). The 25th Knesset voted 62-0 to dissolve on July 17, completing its full four-year constitutional mandate — the first Israeli parliament to do so since 1988. All 62 votes came from coalition members, confirming coalition majority intact at dissolution. Both YES criteria are factually bypassed: (1) Coalition did NOT lose majority — held 62 seats at dissolution; (2) Election fixed at October 27, not earlier than October 27. In a final overnight session the coalition passed judicial overhaul provisions, Haredi draft-exemption legislation, and media oversight measures. Sole remaining YES pathway: post-dissolution constitutional crisis moving election date to before October 27. No precedent or current evidence. P updated 0.45 → 0.06.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas. Self-dissolution with coalition majority intact and election at October 27 = NO (satisfies neither YES criterion).
